73: Two mutants, Rogue and Wolverine, come to a private academy for their kind whose resident superhero team, the X-Men, must oppose a terrorist organization with similar powers.
Trust a few. Fear the rest.
329: A true story of two men who should never have met – a quadriplegic aristocrat who was injured in a paragliding accident and a young man from the projects.
Sometimes you have to reach into someone else's world to find out what's missing in your own.
585: There is a new criminal mastermind at large (Professor Moriarty) and not only is he Holmes’ intellectual equal, but his capacity for evil and lack of conscience may give him an advantage over the detective.

Teaming up with a wisecracking private investigator, Samantha must return to her old ways to take down the people who tried to erase her.
What's forgotten is not always gone.
1097: A conniving Broadway producer and his meek accountant plan to profit from charming wealthy old biddies to invest in an overbudget production, and then put on a sure-fire disaster, so nobody will ask for their money back — and what's more disastrous than a tasteless musical celebrating Adolf Hitler.
Hollywood Never Faced a Zanier Zero Hour!
1353: A renowned New York playwright is enticed to California to write for the movies and discovers the hellish truth of Hollywood.
There's only one thing stranger than what's going on inside his head... What's going on outside.
1609: In the future, an outbreak of canine flu leads the mayor of a Japanese city to banish all dogs to an island used as a garbage dump. The outcasts must soon embark on an epic journey when a 12-year-old boy arrives on the island to find his beloved pet.
Loyalty has a scent. And it smells like rebellion.
1865: Inside the Kit Kat Club of 1931 Berlin, starry-eyed singer Sally Bowles and an impish emcee sound the clarion call to decadent fun, while outside a certain political party grows into a brutal force.
2121: Deloris Van Cartier is again asked to don the nun's habit to help a run-down Catholic school, presided over by Mother Superior. 2377: When a Spanish Jesuit goes into the South American wilderness to build a mission in the hope of converting the Indians of the region, a slave hunter is converted and joins his mission. One will trust in the power of prayer. One will believe in the might of the sword.

A little friendship never killed anyone.
2889: A young Jewish American man endeavors—with the help of eccentric, distant relatives—to find the woman who saved his grandfather during World War II—in a Ukrainian village which was ultimately razed by the Nazis.
3145: A mysterious new shop opens in a small town which always seems to stock the deepest desires of each shopper, with a price far heavier than expected.
3401: When the crew of an American tugboat boards an abandoned Russian research vessel, the alien life form aboard regards them as a virus which must be destroyed.
Life on earth is in for a shock.

He was 98 lbs. of solid nerd until he became...the Toxic Avenger!

Music was his world. Then silence revealed a new one.
4169: A young woman’s quest for revenge against the people who kidnapped and tortured her as a child leads her and her best friend, also a victim of child abuse, on a terrifying journey into a living hell of depravity.

Born without privilege. Bound by tradition. She found the courage to follow her heart.
4937: Eddie, the 40-year-old confirmed bachelor finally says "I do" to the beautiful and sexy Lila. But during their honeymoon in Mexico, the woman of his dreams turns out to be a total nightmare, and the guy who could never pull the trigger realizes he’s jumped the gun.
He waited all his life to get married. Too bad he didn't wait another week.
5449: In early 20th century New York City, an impoverished socialite desperately seeks a suitable husband as she gradually finds herself betrayed by her friends and exiled from high society.
When a woman has the beauty men admire and women envy... it is wise to tread carefully.

Frank's travelling light but carrying excess baggage.

Warning: This is only a love story. Do not try this at home.
6729: A group of eighty American workers are locked in their office and ordered by an unknown voice to participate in a twisted game.

An outrageous new comedy for anyone who's ever had hair.

8009: A documentary examining the decade of the 1970s as a turning point in American cinema. Some of today's best filmmakers interview the influential directors of that time.
8265: In the midst of his crumbling relationship, a radio show host begins speaking to his biggest fan—a young boy—via the telephone. But when questions about the boy's identity come up, the host's life is thrown into chaos.

The story that seduced the world is now the most controversial film of the year.
9545: In 1988, a teenage girl's life is thrown into chaos when her mother disappears.
I was 17 when my mother disappeared…

Harold kicks the fun winning Goal.

Witness the rise of a legend

Inspired by the extraordinary true story.

They get funny when you mess with their money.
14409: Newspaper men compete against each other to find a serial killer dubbed "The Lipstick Killer".
Suspense as startling as a strangled scream!

She's the only girl for him.

16201: A notorious gangster Vedha surrenders himself to encounter specialist Vikram whom he challenges every step of the way by narrating his life events in the form of riddles that needs to be solved in order to capture him.

He's a heartbreaker... lover... loner. keeping up an image can be a full time job.
16713: Teenagers stumble across a prehistoric caveman, who goes on a rampage.
The Crazed Love Of A Prehistoric Giant For A Ravishing Teen-Age Girl!
Mr. Kruger - Helicopter Pilot (as William Lloyd)

Trapped, with their oxygen reserves falling dangerously, they realise the worst is yet to come: they are not alone in the house.

Always unheard… unseen… until he reached out to touch and caress!

Trainees by day, detectives by night.

17993: Bob Ross brought joy to millions as the world's most famous art instructor. But a battle for his business empire cast a shadow over his happy trees.

Even with the arms of her love around her...she still felt the menace of that voice in the night!

He's been a husband, a lover, a cuckold and a Communist. Now he just wants to be free.
Don Calogero / Vico Tricarico / Salvatore Tricarico
19529: When five friends vacation at a remote lake house, they expect nothing less then a good time, unaware that Earth is under attack by an alien invasion and mass-abductions.
They've come to claim what's theirs

20297: In order to settle a business dispute, a mob leader murders one of his own teenage sons. The surviving son vows to avenge his brother's death, and organizes his own gang of teenage killers to destroy his father's organization.

Hard times come again no more.

I know how to act out a fight, not how to actually fight.
24137: When a newly married landlord is murdered, a misfit cop’s investigation is complicated by the victim’s secretive family and his own conflicted heart.

If he only knew what she was doing?

When you go undercover, remember one thing: who you are.

26441: Revolves around a young vlogger, who is also an aspiring actress. Her life turns dramatically when she gets involved in a murder mystery.
26697: Pandian, the son of a cop and a wannabe rowdy, falls in love with Kadambarai, a hearing-impaired girl, who wants him to take on Killivalavan, a gangster-politician who has murdered her parents.
26953: An upcoming film starring Arshad Warsi.

A crazy team for a crazy job

One day, he meets the beautiful Lien, a killer for the evil cult who is equally unsatisfied with her situation, but their love angers both the Wu-Tang clan and the evil cult.

Self - FBI Special Agent in Charge, OKC

Everyone thought they were crazy, until they proved everyone wrong.
30537: Rahman is the custodian of a company and the doctor has told him that he will die soon. He decides to with the help of his friend Anush make a plan and inherit some money for his family.
Haw far do you go for money?

The true life and crimes of Paul Ferris

In the ring of death, only one man can be king!

Poetic, Radical, Original, Unwieldy... Impossible To Forget.

The night long journey of the 4 soldiers discharged from the army.

39753: Ganesh, an unemployed man, lands up in a company where Keerthi, the girl he loves, works but who is already engaged to someone else. Sudden incidents ruin his life and he again comes across her, but refuses to marry her.

They live for lust. They live for power. They live forever.

Movie classified in category I of seismic risk.

A Story of New Love in Old Age

Every era has its own kind of hero.
41801: A traditional Hungarian poetic fairytale that describes the epic adventures of a young shepherd through love, war, magic and death.

The Slipperiest, Sultriest, Sexiest Carwash in Town!

42825: Police commander Simon Weiss, head of the division that supervises Paris’s demi-monde, starts out on his nightly tour of bars, discos and strip clubs, making sure once again that the owners don’t bend the rules too far. Abdel, le dealer de la sanisette

43337: After learning his sister has been mysteriously impregnated, Gana sets out to hunt down the culprit as he discovers similar cases in the city.
43593: Set in the early 20th century, the film follows a game warden who arrives in Florida to enforce conservation laws. He soon finds himself pitted against Cottonmouth, the leader of a fierce group of bird poachers.
STORMING THE HEIGHTS OF MOTION PICTURE GREATNESS!
43849: A nostalgic journey through ’80s Sci-Fi-films, exploring their impact and relevance today, told by the artists who made them and by those who were inspired to turn their visions into reality.

From the sensual world of Harold Robbins comes the story of a woman's struggle for fame in Hollywood.

Innocence can be a dangerous thing to lose.

One way road to the chair for today's greatest menace !

Can such a match work despite snobbery and old associations?
SHE WAITED FIVE YEARS FOR THIS ROLE!

Real Brothers, Real Music, Not Really Naked.

46665: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.
46921: To mark the recent thirtieth anniversary of Sergio Leone’s death, this documentary sets out to pay tribute to one of the great legends of world cinema. The film, which is enriched with precious archive footage from the Cineteca di Bologna, including rare audio recordings and film clips shot behind the scenes, sees for the first time the direct participation of the Leone family and has interviews both with Leone’s longtime collaborators and with icons of Hollywood who have been profoundly influenced by his work.

Yesterday a Lady with a Past — Today the Wife of the Man She Loved!

They gave him the hands of a killer!

Angered by this, he seeks revenge against Velu.

One Man Against the Syndicate - Within the Law or Without!

Fear will grip you by the throat when the evil hand KILLS...KILLS...KILLS

He has the fire of his sword. And the courage of his youth.

François van Vliet / Bruno von Lippe

The LOVE they LAUGH they SING they QUARREL... but always there's MUSIC in the AIR
